title: Standard Chartered mulls folding parts of Zodia Custody in-house: Bloomberg
summary: Standard Chartered is reportedly exploring a shake-up of Zodia Custody that would bring parts of the crypto custodian inside its own investment bank.

title: CZ memoir revives feud with OKX founder Star Xu over contract forgery, Huobi arrest
summary: CZ’s new memoir reignited his long-running feud with OKX founder Star Xu, who called the Binance founder a liar in posts on X.

title: Instant settlement strains crypto’s capital efficiency: Ethan Buchman
summary: Crypto trades settle instantly, but at the cost of capital efficiency. This forces firms to overcollateralize and limits how far markets can scale, says Cosmos co-founder Ethan Buchman.

title: Cango sells 2,000 BTC, cuts Bitcoin production cost by 19% in March
summary: Bitcoin miner Cango said it sold 2,000 BTC to pay off debt and cut its BTC production cost by 19% as part of its strategic pivot to energy and AI infrastructure.

title: South Korea tightens crypto withdrawal-delay exemptions after scam losses
summary: The Financial Services Commission said inconsistent exemption rules created loopholes that allowed funds to move quickly with minimal account history.

title: Stablecoin yields won’t harm banks, White House economists say
summary: White House economists say banning stablecoin yield would add little to bank lending while imposing significant costs on users.

title: South Korea draft bill puts stablecoins, RWAs under finance laws: Report
summary: The draft proposal from South Korea’s ruling party reportedly bars stablecoin interest and calls for technical standards to ensure interoperability across blockchain networks.

title: Thailand proposes tighter scrutiny of funders behind crypto firms
summary: Thailand’s SEC proposes tightening funding rules for cryptocurrency companies to include anyone backing major shareholders, directly or indirectly.

title: NYT revives Adam Back theory in latest bid to identify Bitcoin creator
summary: A New York Times investigation points to Adam Back as Satoshi Nakamoto, but the Blockstream CEO denies it, and critics say proof is still missing.

title: Oil falls, Bitcoin jumps to $72K, but is this BTC price breakout for real?
summary: Bitcoin rose toward $72,000 after US President Donald Trump confirmed a ceasefire agreement with Iran, sending oil prices crashing below $100.
